mentions.name: Jiracule
mentions.description: A lightweight, fast alternate web client for Jira that avoids the heavy memory usage and slowness of the official Jira interface.
mentions.problem: The official Jira web client is slow and resource-heavy, taking around 1GB of RAM.
mentions.source_excerpt: An alternate web client for Jira that doesn't take a 1GB of ram and slow as molasses.
mentions.author: pavo-etc
